verses.pali: “Rūpaṁ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya;
verses.english: “Mendicants, without directly knowing and completely understanding form, without dispassion for it and giving it up, you can’t end suffering.

verses.pali: vedanaṁ anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya;
verses.english: Without directly knowing and completely understanding feeling …

verses.pali: saṅkhāre anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya;
viññāṇaṁ anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: consciousness, without dispassion for it and giving it up, you can’t end suffering.

verses.pali: Rūpañca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya;
verses.english: By directly knowing and completely understanding form, having dispassion for it and giving it up, you can end suffering.
By directly knowing and completely understanding feeling …

verses.pali: viññāṇaṁ abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
verses.english: consciousness, having dispassion for it and giving it up, you can end suffering.”
